title: Jacob Keyes:
title_q: “Live Every Day Like It's Your Last”
title_short: Jacob Keyes · AYH · Live Every Day Like It's Your Last
headline: The host of the night tells us he is always happy, why, and then gives the whole world one message: live every day like it could be your last.
story: Jacob Keyes is the Chairman of the Iowa Tribe of Oklahoma and the owner of Skydance Brewing, where the reception happened. His answer is pure joy and conviction. Family, Tribe and the people at the brewery are why he is happy. Then the turn: "you're going to die", and the payoff, "live every day as if this could be the last day of your life".
do: Let his energy carry it. Fast, clean cuts between sentences.
Show the brewery and the people when he talks about them.
Hold one beat of silence after "you're going to die" before the payoff.
Keep "this is gonna sound crazy". It is part of his charm.
dont: No crew talk: cut "three, two, go", "say that again", "good job, man".
No logo or name card at 0:00.
Super is "Jacob Keyes / Owner, Skydance Brewing Company". No Tribe on the super.
No sad or heavy music. This is a happy video.

transcript:
--- 26-10-09 C1 Happy - NIWRC Event 12.MP4 ---
[00:00.4] All right, here we go. So always into here. Here we go. Three, two, go.
[00:07.1] Say that again.
[00:09.1] Am I happy?
[00:11.2] That's the question. I'm always happy. Absolutely.
[00:18.6] My family is the source of my happiness, my tribe, my community. Those things are the source of my happiness.
[00:26.8] I mean, I'm just lucky. I have a wife. I've got kids.
[00:29.9] I've got all of these people that work with me here at the brewery, our tribe at the Iowa tribe.
[00:34.6] We're all a big huge family and everywhere I go from the time I wake up till I go to bed,
[00:39.4] I'm surrounded by people that love me. And if you can't be happy with that, then you're just incapable of being happy.
[00:55.0] Oh my gosh, if I could give one message to the entire world,
[00:58.5] it would be, this is gonna sound crazy, but it would be that you're going to die.
[01:02.9] When I say that, what that means is live every day as if this could be the last day of your life.
[01:08.2] And if you think about it that way, you'll do things, you'll take action.
[01:12.2] You will do things and make things happen that you never thought of doing before.
[01:17.7] Good job, man.
